description2: Free Fire Arab League (FFAL) is the top league for the Free Fire pro-teams in the Middle East and North Africa .nnThe champions of FFAL will represent the Middle East and North Africa region as the first seed, and will compete in the FFWS Finals.nnThe 2nd placed team in FFAL will represent the Middle East and North Africa region as the second seed, and will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.
